'''Depot Loader''' is an [[AIC]] [[Facilities|facility]] in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

{{Item description|A placeable loading point that delivers goods from the AIC Factory to a local depot. The Depot Loader must be placed right next to the Depot Bus.|An upgrade plan was stipulated after the AIC Factory was deployed for a second time in a high-threat area. Blight-resistant steel was used to construct Depot Loaders and Depot Unloaders.}}
==Usage==
A placeable loading point that delivers goods from the AIC Factory to a local depot. The Depot Loader must be placed right next to the Depot Bus.
==Acquisition==
*Requirement : [[AIC Plan#Basic AIC Plan|Basic AIC Plan - Basic AIC II - Depot Bus]]
